  /* ---------- 6 · Feedback (Cursed UI #1, honest rating) ----------
     Rate it 1 star. The row keeps rolling, and hover too long and star 5 slides under your pointer. */
  LEVELS.push({
    id: 'rate', where: 'Feedback', goal: 'Rate it 1 star', note: 'be honest',
    html: () => `${app('Feedback · Exit survey')}
      <h1 class="h">How was Orbit?</h1>
      <p class="sub">Your rating helps us keep you.</p>
      <div class="track" data-r="track" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Rating"></div>
      <div class="slabel" data-r="label">Tap a star</div>
      <div class="quote" data-r="quote">“Orbit has never had a 1&#8209;star review.”<br><b>Be the first.</b></div>`,
    make(el, api) {
      const R = n => $(`[data-r="${n}"]`, el);
      const track = R('track'), label = R('label');
      const STAR = 'M25 3.2l6.5 13.4 14.7 2.1-10.7 10.3 2.6 14.6L25 36.7l-13.1 6.9 2.6-14.6L3.8 18.7l14.7-2.1z';
      const u = api.uid;
      const W = Math.min(330, el.clientWidth - 52);
      track.style.width = W + 'px';
      const N = 5, GAP = W / N, PERIOD = GAP * N, LEAD = 4;
      const WORDS = ['Terrible', 'Meh', 'Okay', 'Good', 'Amazing'];
      track.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><defs><linearGradient id="gold${u}" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffdb7a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f29d34"/></linearGradient></defs></svg>`);
      const svgStar = `<svg viewBox="0 0 50 50"><path d="${STAR}" fill="#faf9f6" stroke="#d9d5cc" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g class="on"><path d="${STAR}" fill="url(#gold${u})" stroke="#e39a32" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round"/><path d="M25 8.5l4.6 9.4" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".55" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/></g></svg>`;
      const stars = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        const mk = twin => {
          const b = document.createElement('button'); b.className = 'star' + (i === 0 ? ' one' : ''); b.type = 'button';
          if (twin) { b.tabIndex = -1; b.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); } else { b.setAttribute('role', 'radio'); b.setAttribute('aria-label', `${i + 1} star${i ? 's' : ''}`); }
          b.innerHTML = svgStar + `<i>${i + 1}</i>`; track.appendChild(b); return b;
        };
        const e1 = mk(false), e2 = mk(true);
        const rest = (i - (N - 1) / 2) * GAP;
        stars.push({ i, el: e1, tw: e2, on: [e1.querySelector('.on'), e2.querySelector('.on')], rest, x: rest, v: 0, k: 560 - (LEAD - i) * 80, f: 0, fv: 0, vis: rest });
        e1.addEventListener('keydown', ev => { if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') { ev.preventDefault(); rate(i + 1); } });
      }
      let roll = 0, hovering = false, dodgeAt = 0, rated = false, hoverIdx = -1, dodging = false;
      const ROLL = 64;
      const wrap = x => ((x + PERIOD / 2) % PERIOD + PERIOD) % PERIOD - PERIOD / 2;
      const tr = () => track.getBoundingClientRect();
      const zone = () => { const r = tr(); return K.px > r.left + 4 && K.px < r.right - 4 && K.py > r.top - 8 && K.py < r.bottom + 8; };
      function starAt(x) {
        const r = tr(), local = x - (r.left + r.width / 2);
        let best = null, bd = 1e9;
        for (const s of stars) { const d = Math.abs(wrap(s.vis - local)); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = s; } }
        return bd < GAP * .62 ? best : null;
      }
      function rate(v) {
        if (rated) return; rated = true;
        stars.forEach(s => s.fv += 9);
        if (v === 1) {
          label.textContent = '1 star. Noted.'; label.className = 'slabel hot';
          R('quote').innerHTML = '“Orbit has <b>one</b> 1&#8209;star review.”<br>We will be reading it. Slowly.';
          api.win('1 star. Honest.');
        } else if (v === 5) {
          label.textContent = '5 stars! Thank you!'; label.className = 'slabel hot';
          api.fail('Star 5 slid under you. +3 s', { penalty: true, delay: 700 });
        } else {
          label.textContent = `${v} stars? Rounded up to 5.`; label.className = 'slabel hot';
          api.fail(`${v} stars, rounded up to 5. Try 1.`, { penalty: false, delay: 600 });
        }
      }
      return {
        focus() { },
        down(e) { if (rated) return; if (!inside(track, e.clientX, e.clientY, 8)) return; const s = starAt(e.clientX); if (s) rate(s.i + 1); },
        update(dt) {
          const was = hovering;
          hovering = !rated && zone() && !K.touch;
          const r = tr(), local = K.px - (r.left + r.width / 2);
          if (hovering && !was) { dodgeAt = K.now + 240; stars.forEach((s, i) => s.delay = dodgeAt + 120 + (LEAD - i) * 45); }
          dodging = hovering && K.now >= dodgeAt;
          if (!rated) roll -= ROLL * dt * (dodging ? 0 : 1);
          // dodging: star 5 lands under the pointer, everything else trails behind it
          const offset = dodging ? wrap(local - (stars[LEAD].rest + roll)) : 0;
          stars.forEach(s => {
            const c = 2 * Math.sqrt(s.k) * .72;
            s.v += (s.k * (offset - (s.x - s.rest)) - c * s.v) * dt; s.x += s.v * dt;
            s.vis = wrap(s.x + roll);
          });
          const hs = hovering ? starAt(K.px) : null;
          hoverIdx = rated ? hoverIdx : hs ? hs.i : -1;
          stars.forEach(s => {
            const ft = rated ? (s.i === hoverIdx || hoverIdx < 0 ? 1 : .0) : s.i === hoverIdx ? 1 : 0;
            const fk = 340, fc = 2 * Math.sqrt(fk) * .45;
            s.fv += (fk * (ft - s.f) - fc * s.fv) * dt; s.f += s.fv * dt;
          });
          if (!rated) {
            const t = hoverIdx >= 0 ? (dodging && hoverIdx === 4 ? '5 stars · Amazing' : `${hoverIdx + 1} · ${WORDS[hoverIdx]}`) : 'Tap a star';
            if (label.textContent !== t) { label.textContent = t; label.className = 'slabel' + (hoverIdx === 4 ? ' hot' : ''); }
          }
        },
        render() {
          for (const s of stars) {
            const sp = Math.min(Math.abs(s.v) / 2600, .3), sx = 1 + sp, sy = 1 / Math.pow(sx, .7);
            const rot = clamp(s.v / 70, -16, 16);
            const x = s.vis, x2 = x < 0 ? x + PERIOD : x - PERIOD;
            const tail = ` rotate(${rot.toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${sx.toFixed(3)},${sy.toFixed(3)})`;
            s.el.style.transform = `translateX(${x.toFixed(2)}px)` + tail;
            s.tw.style.transform = `translateX(${x2.toFixed(2)}px)` + tail;
            const f = Math.max(0, s.f);
            for (const on of s.on) { on.style.transform = `scale(${f.toFixed(3)})`; on.style.opacity = Math.min(1, f * 1.6).toFixed(3); }
          }
        },
        probe: {
          star: i => { const r = tr(), s = stars[i]; return [r.left + r.width / 2 + s.vis, r.top + r.height * .42]; },
          track: () => { const r = tr(); return [r.left, r.top, r.width, r.height]; },
          dodging: () => dodging, roll: () => ROLL, gap: () => GAP
        }
      };
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 7 · Cookies (new) ----------
     "Reject all" runs from your pointer and hops around. "Accept all" never moves. */
  LEVELS.push({
    id: 'cookie', where: 'Cookie banner', goal: 'Click "Reject all"', note: 'it runs',
    html: () => `${app('Cancel · Final steps')}
      <h1 class="h">Almost there.</h1>
      <p class="sub">One quick thing first.</p>
      <div class="ghostline" style="width:80%"></div><div class="ghostline" style="width:64%"></div><div class="ghostline" style="width:72%"></div>
      <div class="shade"></div>
      <div class="banner" data-r="banner" role="dialog" aria-label="Cookie consent">
        <h2><svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22"><path d="M11 2a9 9 0 1 0 9 9 3 3 0 0 1-3.4-3.3A3 3 0 0 1 13.2 4 2.6 2.6 0 0 1 11 2z" fill="#f4e3c4" stroke="#a8681a" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="8" cy="10" r="1.3" fill="#a8681a"/><circle cx="12" cy="14.6" r="1.3" fill="#a8681a"/><circle cx="7.4" cy="15" r="1" fill="#a8681a"/></svg>We value your privacy</h2>
        <p>We and our <b>214 partners</b> use cookies to keep you subscribed.</p>
        <button class="manage" data-r="manage">Manage 214 partners</button>
        <button class="reject" data-r="reject">Reject all</button>
        <button class="btn" data-r="accept">Accept all</button>
      </div>`,
    make(el, api) {
      const R = n => $(`[data-r="${n}"]`, el);
      const banner = R('banner'), reject = R('reject'), accept = R('accept');
      const rnd = rng(7 + (MANUAL ? 0 : Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6)));
      const p = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 }, sq = { x: 0, v: 0 };
      let won = false, nextHop = 0, target = null, bw = 0, bh = 40, box = null, flee = 0;
      function bounds() {
        const W = banner.clientWidth, top = 112, bottom = banner.clientHeight - 18 - 50 - 46;
        bw = reject.offsetWidth;
        return { x0: 14, x1: W - bw - 14, y0: top, y1: bottom };
      }
      box = bounds();
      p.x = box.x1; p.y = box.y0 + 8;
      const spots = () => [[box.x0, box.y0], [box.x1, box.y0], [(box.x0 + box.x1) / 2, box.y1], [box.x0, box.y1], [box.x1, box.y1], [(box.x0 + box.x1) * .3, (box.y0 + box.y1) / 2], [(box.x0 + box.x1) * .72, (box.y0 + box.y1) / 2]];
      function hop() {
        const s = spots(), cur = [p.x, p.y];
        let pick, tries = 0;
        do { pick = s[Math.floor(rnd() * s.length)]; tries++; } while (tries < 8 && Math.hypot(pick[0] - cur[0], pick[1] - cur[1]) < 60);
        target = { x: pick[0], y: pick[1] };
        sq.v += 10;
        nextHop = K.now + 820 + rnd() * 480;
      }
      nextHop = K.now + 900;
      reject.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (won) return; won = true;
        reject.textContent = 'Rejected';
        api.tween(380, q => banner.style.transform = `translateY(${q * 340}px)`, ease.inOut, 120);
        // the page behind wakes up: shade lifts, the skeleton lines fill in gold
        const shade = $('.shade', el), sub = $('.sub', el);
        api.tween(320, q => { shade.style.opacity = 1 - q; }, ease.out, 200);
        api.tween(1, () => { sub.textContent = 'Cookies: none. Partners: 0.'; }, ease.lin, 220);
        $$('.ghostline', el).forEach((g, i) => api.tween(300, q => { g.style.background = `linear-gradient(90deg,#ffe7ab ${q * 100}%,#f0eee9 ${q * 100}%)`; }, ease.out, 260 + i * 70));
        api.win('Rejected. All 214 of them.');
      });
      accept.addEventListener('click', () => { if (!won) api.fail('Accepted. 214 partners say thanks. +3 s', { penalty: true }); });
      R('manage').addEventListener('click', () => { if (!won) api.say('Loading 214 toggles… (no)', 'bad', 1200); });
      return {
        focus() { },
        update(dt) {
          if (won) return;
          box = bounds();
          const br = banner.getBoundingClientRect();
          const cx = br.left + p.x + bw / 2, cy = br.top + p.y + bh / 2;
          const mouse = !K.touch && K.px > -900;
          const dx = cx - K.px, dy = cy - K.py, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          let ax = 0, ay = 0;
          if (mouse && d < 92) {
            const f = (1 - d / 92) * 5200;
            ax += dx / (d || 1) * f; ay += dy / (d || 1) * f;
            flee = K.now; target = null;
          } else if (target) {
            ax += 120 * (target.x - p.x) - 2 * Math.sqrt(120) * .8 * p.vx;
            ay += 120 * (target.y - p.y) - 2 * Math.sqrt(120) * .8 * p.vy;
          }
          if (K.now > nextHop && K.now - flee > 500) hop();
          p.vx += ax * dt; p.vy += ay * dt;
          const fr = Math.pow(.02, dt); p.vx *= fr; p.vy *= fr;
          const sp = Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy), MAXS = 760;
          if (sp > MAXS) { p.vx *= MAXS / sp; p.vy *= MAXS / sp; }
          p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
          if (p.x < box.x0) { p.x = box.x0; p.vx = Math.abs(p.vx) * .2; sq.v += 2; }
          if (p.x > box.x1) { p.x = box.x1; p.vx = -Math.abs(p.vx) * .2; sq.v += 2; }
          if (p.y < box.y0) { p.y = box.y0; p.vy = Math.abs(p.vy) * .2; }
          if (p.y > box.y1) { p.y = box.y1; p.vy = -Math.abs(p.vy) * .2; }
          spring(sq, 0, 420, .3, dt);
        },
        render() {
          const sp = Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy), st = Math.min(.12, sp / 5000);
          const ang = Math.atan2(p.vy, p.vx);
          const s = 1 + sq.x * .02;
          reject.style.transform = `translate(${p.x.toFixed(2)}px,${p.y.toFixed(2)}px) rotate(${(clamp(p.vx / 60, -9, 9)).toFixed(2)}deg) scale(${(s * (1 + st * Math.abs(Math.cos(ang)))).toFixed(3)},${(s * (1 + st * Math.abs(Math.sin(ang))) / (1 + st)).toFixed(3)})`;
        },
        probe: { reject: () => center(reject), accept: () => center(accept), vel: () => [p.vx, p.vy] }
      };
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 8 · Your data (Cursed UI #7, undo undo) ----------
     Delete your data, then dismiss the toast before its Undo button presses itself. */
  LEVELS.push({
    id: 'undo', where: 'Your data', goal: 'Delete it, then close the toast', note: 'before it undoes',
    html: () => `${app('Account · Data')}
      <h1 class="h">Delete your data</h1>
      <p class="sub">Required before we close your account.</p>
      <ul class="files">
        <li class="file" data-r="row"><div class="in"><span class="ft" style="background:#e08a3c">ZIP</span><div><b>orbit-projects</b><span>41 projects · 2.4 GB</span></div>
          <button class="trash" data-r="trash" aria-label="Delete orbit-projects"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 15 15"><path d="M2.5 4h10M6 4V2.6h3V4M3.8 4l.7 8.6h6l.7-8.6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button></div><span class="flash"></span></li>
        <li class="file"><div class="in"><span class="ft" style="background:#7a6cf0">PDF</span><div><b>invoices-2026</b><span>Kept for 7 years</span></div><span class="locked"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 11 11"><rect x="2" y="5" width="7" height="5" rx="1.3" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M3.6 5V3.6a1.9 1.9 0 0 1 3.8 0V5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg>Locked</span></div></li>
        <li class="file"><div class="in"><span class="ft" style="background:#3aa6a0">CSV</span><div><b>marketing-profile</b><span>Shared with partners</span></div><span class="locked"><svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 11 11"><rect x="2" y="5" width="7" height="5" rx="1.3" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M3.6 5V3.6a1.9 1.9 0 0 1 3.8 0V5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/></svg>Locked</span></div></li>
      </ul>
      <div class="slot">
        <div class="toast" data-r="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite">
          <span class="tmsg" data-r="tmsg"><span data-r="tt">Data deleted.</span><span class="count" data-r="count"></span></span>
          <button class="undo" data-r="undo">Undo<span class="ring2" data-r="r2"></span></button>
          <button class="close" data-r="close" aria-label="Dismiss"><svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 12 12"><path d="M1.5 1.5l9 9M10.5 1.5l-9 9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
          <span class="timebar" data-r="tbar"></span>
        </div>
      </div>`,
    make(el, api) {
      const R = n => $(`[data-r="${n}"]`, el);
      const row = R('row'), rowIn = row.querySelector('.in'), flash = row.querySelector('.flash');
      const toast = R('toast'), tmsg = R('tmsg'), tt = R('tt'), count = R('count'), undo = R('undo'), tbar = R('tbar');
      const SELF = [1000, 760, 580, 440, 360];
      const open = { x: 1, v: 0 }, up = { x: 0, v: 0 };
      let present = true, shown = false, tries = 0, undone = 0, pending = null, pendAt = 0, pendMs = 1, won = false;
      function setMsg(txt, n) {
        tt.textContent = txt; count.style.display = n > 1 ? 'inline-block' : 'none'; count.textContent = '×' + n;
        api.tween(260, p => tmsg.style.transform = `scale(${1 + .06 * (1 - p)})`);
      }
      function press(self) {
        api.tween(90, p => undo.style.transform = `scale(${1 - .1 * p})`);
        api.tween(260, p => undo.style.transform = `scale(${.9 + .1 * p})`, ease.back, 100);
        if (self) { const r = R('r2'); api.tween(520, p => { r.style.opacity = (1 - p) * .9; r.style.transform = `scale(${.5 + p * .9})`; }); }
      }
      function restore() { present = true; api.tween(650, p => flash.style.opacity = 1 - p); }
      R('trash').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!present || won) return;
        present = false; shown = true; setMsg('Data deleted.', 0);
        const ms = SELF[Math.min(tries, SELF.length - 1)]; tries++;
        pendAt = K.now; pendMs = ms;
        pending = api.later(ms, () => {
          pending = null; press(true); restore(); undone++;
          setMsg('Nobody clicked Undo. Restored.', undone);
          api.say('The Undo button pressed itself.', 'bad', 1300);
          api.later(900, () => { if (present && !won) shown = false; });
        });
      });
      undo.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (won || present) return;
        if (pending) { api.cancel(pending); pending = null; }
        press(false); restore(); setMsg('Restored. Good call!', 0);
        api.later(700, () => { if (!won) shown = false; });
      });
      R('close').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (won || !shown) return;
        if (!present && pending) {
          api.cancel(pending); pending = null; won = true; shown = false;
          api.win('Deleted. For real.');
        } else { shown = false; }
      });
      return {
        focus() { },
        update(dt) { spring(open, present ? 1 : 0, 420, .85, dt); spring(up, shown ? 1 : 0, 380, .78, dt); },
        render() {
          const o = clamp(open.x, 0, 1);
          row.style.height = (56 * ease.inOut(clamp(o / .7, 0, 1))).toFixed(2) + 'px';
          rowIn.style.opacity = clamp((o - .7) / .3, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
          toast.style.opacity = clamp(up.x * 1.6, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
          toast.style.transform = `translateY(${(26 * (1 - up.x)).toFixed(2)}px) scale(${(.96 + .04 * clamp(up.x, 0, 1.05)).toFixed(4)})`;
          toast.style.pointerEvents = shown && up.x > .6 ? 'auto' : 'none';
          tbar.style.transform = `scaleX(${pending ? clamp(1 - (K.now - pendAt) / pendMs, 0, 1).toFixed(3) : 0})`;
        },
        probe: { trash: () => center(R('trash')), close: () => center(R('close')), up: () => up.x }
      };
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 9 · Confirm (new) ----------
     Hold the button for two seconds. It starts wandering off the moment you hold it. */
  LEVELS.push({
    id: 'hold', where: 'Confirm', goal: 'Hold the button to cancel', note: 'follow it',
    html: () => `${app('Cancel · Confirm')}
      <h1 class="h">Last step.</h1>
      <p class="sub">Hold the button to cancel Orbit Pro.</p>
      <div class="arena" data-r="arena">
        <div class="offer" data-r="offer"><b>Wait! 3 months free?<span>then $39/mo</span></b><button tabindex="-1" data-r="claim">Claim</button></div>
        <button class="hold" data-r="hold"><i class="gfill" data-r="gfill"></i><span data-r="hl">Hold to cancel</span></button>
        <div class="pct" data-r="pct">0%</div>
      </div>`,
    make(el, api) {
      const R = n => $(`[data-r="${n}"]`, el);
      const arena = R('arena'), btn = R('hold'), gfill = R('gfill'), hl = R('hl'), pct = R('pct'), offer = R('offer');
      const HOLD = 2100;
      let prog = 0, holding = false, onIt = false, keyHold = false, won = false, t = 0, lost = 0;
      const b = { x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0 }, sq = { x: 0, v: 0 }, off = { x: 0, v: 0 };
      const aw = () => arena.clientWidth, ah = () => arena.clientHeight;
      b.x = aw() / 2; b.y = ah() / 2 + 6;
      const WORDS = [[0, 'Hold to cancel'], [.12, 'Cancelling…'], [.38, 'Are you sure?'], [.62, 'Really sure?'], [.85, 'Okay, okay…']];
      R('claim').addEventListener('click', () => { if (!won && !holding) api.fail('3 months free. Then $39/mo. +3 s', { penalty: true }); });
      btn.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if ((e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') && !won) { e.preventDefault(); keyHold = true; } });
      btn.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') keyHold = false; });
      btn.addEventListener('blur', () => keyHold = false);
      btn.addEventListener('click', e => e.preventDefault());
      return {
        focus() { },
        down(e) { if (won) return; if (inside(btn, e.clientX, e.clientY, 6)) { holding = true; } },
        up() { if (holding && !won && prog > .05) api.say('Let go? Back to zero it goes.', 'bad', 1100); holding = false; },
        update(dt) {
          if (won) { spring(sq, 0, 300, .4, dt); return; }
          const tol = K.touch ? 26 : 12;
          onIt = keyHold || (holding && inside(btn, K.px, K.py, tol));
          const active = keyHold || holding;
          if (onIt) prog += dt * 1000 / HOLD;
          else prog -= dt * (active ? .55 : 1.6);
          if (holding && !onIt) lost += dt; else lost = 0;
          prog = clamp(prog, 0, 1);
          // wander: a Lissajous that speeds up with progress, with two sudden dashes
          if (active) t += dt * (.9 + prog * 1.5);
          const W = aw(), H = ah(), mx = W / 2, my = H / 2 + 6;
          const ampX = (W / 2 - 108) * clamp(prog * 1.6 + .12, 0, 1), ampY = (H / 2 - 44) * clamp(prog * 1.6 + .08, 0, 1);
          const tx = mx + Math.sin(t * 2.1) * ampX + (prog > .45 && prog < .58 ? 38 : 0), ty = my + Math.sin(t * 2.9 + .6) * ampY;
          const k = active ? 160 : 60;
          b.vx += (k * (tx - b.x) - 2 * Math.sqrt(k) * .7 * b.vx) * dt; b.vy += (k * (ty - b.y) - 2 * Math.sqrt(k) * .7 * b.vy) * dt;
          b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt;
          spring(sq, onIt ? 1 : 0, 300, .5, dt);
          spring(off, prog > .4 ? 1 : 0, 220, .6, dt);
          if (prog >= 1) {

            hl.textContent = 'Cancelled.'; btn.classList.add('lit');
            api.win('');
          }
        },
        render() {
          btn.style.transform = `translate(${b.x.toFixed(2)}px,${b.y.toFixed(2)}px) scale(${(1 - .03 * sq.x).toFixed(3)}) rotate(${clamp(b.vx / 90, -6, 6).toFixed(2)}deg)`;
          gfill.style.transform = `scaleX(${prog.toFixed(4)})`;
          btn.classList.toggle('lit', prog > .55);
          if (!won) { let w = WORDS[0][1]; for (const [p, s] of WORDS) if (prog >= p) w = s; if (hl.textContent !== w) hl.textContent = w; }
          pct.textContent = Math.round(prog * 100) + '%';
          offer.style.opacity = clamp(off.x, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
          offer.style.transform = `translateY(${(-10 * (1 - off.x)).toFixed(2)}px)`;
          offer.style.pointerEvents = off.x > .5 && !holding ? 'auto' : 'none';
        },
        probe: { btn: () => center(btn), prog: () => prog }
      };
    }
  });

  /* ================================================================ input */
  addEventListener('pointermove', e => { K.px = e.clientX; K.py = e.clientY; K.touch = e.pointerType === 'touch'; moveCursor(); }, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
    K.px = e.clientX; K.py = e.clientY; K.touch = e.pointerType === 'touch'; K.down = true;
    cursorPress();
    if (phase === 'play' && inst && !inst.own.won && inst.down) inst.down(e);
  });
  const release = e => {
    K.down = false;
    if (phase === 'play' && inst && inst.up && !inst.api.dead) inst.up(e);
    if (e && e.pointerType === 'touch') { K.px = K.py = -999; }
    moveCursor();
  };
  addEventListener('pointerup', release);
  addEventListener('pointercancel', release);
  addEventListener('blur', () => release());
  document.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { if (!K.down) { K.px = K.py = -999; } });
  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && phase === 'start' && document.activeElement && document.activeElement.id !== 'startBtn') { e.preventDefault(); go(); }
    if (phase === 'play' && inst && inst.key) inst.key(e);
  });
  addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());

  /* ================================================================ reel cursor + overlays */
  const cursor = { el: null, ring: null, shapes: null, scale: 1 };
  if (REEL) {
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div id="cursor"><div id="ring"></div>
      <svg id="c-arrow" width="26" height="34" viewBox="0 0 26 34"><path d="M2 2 L2 26 L8.2 20.4 L12.4 30.4 L16.6 28.6 L12.5 18.9 L20.8 18.6 Z" fill="#111" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
      <svg id="c-hand" width="30" height="34" viewBox="0 0 30 34" style="display:none;left:-9px;top:-2px"><path d="M10 15V5.2a2.6 2.6 0 0 1 5.2 0V13 M15.2 12.6a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 5 0v1.8 M20.2 13.6a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 5 0v6.2c0 6.6-4 11.2-10 11.2-4.6 0-6.7-2.2-9.4-6.5L3 19.6a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4.2-2.7L10 20.8V15" fill="#fff" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
      <svg id="c-grab" width="30" height="30" viewBox="0 0 30 30" style="display:none;left:-15px;top:-13px"><path d="M8.2 11.4a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 4.8 0v-1a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 4.8 0v1a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 4.8 0v1.4a2.4 2.4 0 0 1 4.6.9v4.8c0 5.6-3.8 9.4-9.4 9.4-4.2 0-6.4-1.8-8.6-5.2l-2.4-3.8a2.3 2.3 0 0 1 3.4-3z M13 11.4v4 M17.8 11.4v4 M22.6 12.8v3" fill="#fff" stroke="#111" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>`);
    cursor.el = $('#cursor'); cursor.ring = $('#ring'); cursor.shapes = { arrow: $('#c-arrow'), hand: $('#c-hand'), grab: $('#c-grab') };
  }
  function moveCursor() {
    if (!REEL) return;
    const el = document.elementFromPoint(K.px, K.py);
    const kind = K.down && el && (el.closest('.srow') || el.closest('.knob')) ? 'grab' : el && (el.closest('button') || el.closest('.srow') || el.closest('.track')) ? 'hand' : 'arrow';
    for (const k in cursor.shapes) cursor.shapes[k].style.display = k === kind ? '' : 'none';
    cursor.el.style.transform = `translate(${K.px}px,${K.py}px) scale(${cursor.scale})`;
  }
  function cursorPress() {
    if (!REEL) return;
    tween(90, p => { cursor.scale = 1 - .14 * p; moveCursor(); });
    tween(300, p => { cursor.scale = .86 + .14 * p; moveCursor(); }, ease.back, 120);
    tween(480, p => { cursor.ring.style.opacity = (1 - p) * .9; cursor.ring.style.transform = `scale(${.4 + p * 1.1})`; });
  }
  let outroOn = false;
  function outro(on) {
    if (on === outroOn) return; outroOn = on;
    const top = $('.reel-top'), out = $('.reel-out');
    tween(320, p => { const q = on ? p : 1 - p;
      top.style.opacity = clamp(1 - q / .35, 0, 1); top.style.transform = `translateY(${-q * 10}px)`;
      const o = clamp((q - .2) / .5, 0, 1); out.style.opacity = o; out.style.transform = `translateY(${(1 - o) * 10}px)`; }, ease.lin);
  }

  /* ================================================================ loop */
  function renderTimer() {
    const s = fmt(elapsed());
    if (tnum.dataset.v !== s) { tnum.dataset.v = s; tnum.innerHTML = digits(s); }
  }
  function tick(ms) {
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ms / 4));
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const dt = ms / n / 1000;
      K.now += ms / n;
      if (inst && !inst.api.dead) { inst.api.runTimers(); if (inst.update && !(inst.own.won && phase !== 'between' && false)) inst.update(dt); }
      spring(shake, 0, 520, .16, dt); spring(kick, 0, 380, .35, dt); spring(timerPop, 0, 420, .3, dt);
    }
    for (let i = tweens.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const tw = tweens[i];
      if (K.now < tw.t0) continue;
      const p = tw.dur <= 1 ? 1 : Math.min(1, (K.now - tw.t0) / tw.dur);
      if (!tw.dead) tw.fn(tw.e(p));
      if (p >= 1) { const j = tweens.indexOf(tw); if (j >= 0) tweens.splice(j, 1); }
    }
    if (inst && !inst.api.dead && inst.render) inst.render();
    card.style.transform = `translateX(${(shake.x * .022).toFixed(2)}px) rotate(${(shake.x * .0016).toFixed(3)}deg) scale(${(1 + kick.x * .004).toFixed(4)})`;
    timerEl.style.transform = `scale(${(1 + timerPop.x * .012).toFixed(4)})`;
    renderTimer();
  }
  window.__tick = tick;
  window.__probe = (name, ...a) => inst && inst.probe && inst.probe[name] ? inst.probe[name](...a) : null;
  window.__state = () => ({ phase, level: phase === 'play' || phase === 'between' ? LEVELS[idx].id : phase, idx, elapsed: elapsed(), penalties: penaltyCount, won: !!(inst && inst.own.won) });
  window.__go = go;
  window.__outro = outro;

  /* short screens (iPhone SE in the Instagram browser is ~550 px tall): scale the whole column instead of cutting the card.
     Hit-testing reads clientX/Y against getBoundingClientRect, so it stays exact under the transform. */
  const gameEl = $('#game');
  function fitGame() {
    if (REEL) return;
    gameEl.classList.remove('fit'); gameEl.style.transform = '';
    const need = gameEl.scrollHeight, have = innerHeight;
    if (need > have + 1) {
      const s = Math.max(.72, have / need);
      gameEl.classList.add('fit'); gameEl.style.transform = `scale(${s.toFixed(4)})`;
    }
  }
  addEventListener('resize', fitGame);
  if (window.visualViewport) visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', fitGame);

  buildBar();
  startScreen();
  fitGame();
  const jump = parseInt(qs.get('level'), 10);
  if (jump >= 1 && jump <= LEVELS.length) go(jump - 1);
  if (!MANUAL) {
    let last = performance.now();
    requestAnimationFrame(function loop(t) { tick(Math.min(50, t - last)); last = t; requestAnimationFrame(loop); });
  } else tick(16);
})();
</script>
</body>
